text:
noah: Quick preflight: rolling llm-router v6 tonight 04:00 UTC. Flag: ff.llmroute.v6_chain. Rollout plan: 1% -> 10% after 12m -> 40% after 30m -> 100% after 60m. Holdpoints at each step. We'll pin canary cohorts to model v3.2.0 with sticky pin. Quiet window 03:45-05:00 UTC.

emi: job db-98022 created. Requesting ack-chain: no auto-advance from 10% -> 40% until both release-leads and infra approve. Manual ack via deploybot reaction or `/deploy ack`.

claire: Metrics to watch: p95, 5xx, mem OOM, and a small generation-regression eval (smoke_v6). Runbook gates: p95 > 260ms OR 5xx > 0.5% for 3m -> soft-fallback then pause. Generation delta > 3 pts -> immediate pause + page.

noah: Added a token ceiling for canary (800 tps) for first 15m to avoid cache stampede and a short softfallback to v5-pool for 45s on first anomaly. Also enabling a 90s drainback before each bump.

deploybot: job db-98022 scheduled by @noah. Steps: set ff.llmroute.v6_chain=1% @04:00 hold; advance 10% @04:12 hold (requires release-leads + infra ack); advance 40% @04:42 hold (requires same); advance 100% @05:00 (release-leads signoff). Auto-gates and softfallback configured. Audit events enabled.

emi: Please paste quick rollback/unpin commands here so oncall can pin them in notes.

noah: Rollback snippets (ops-safe):

```bash
# abort deploy
deploybot abort db-98022 --reason "rollback: elevated errors or quality regression"
# turn feature flag off
redwoodctl flags set ff.llmroute.v6_chain 0 --note "emergency revert"
# force immediate routing to v5-pool
redwoodctl routing force-backend llm-route v5-pool --duration 180
# unpin canary cohorts
redwoodctl runtime unpin --service llm-route --cohorts canary,staged
# set sticky pin to safe model
redwoodctl runtime set-pin --service llm-route --model v3.1.8 --cohorts canary,staged --sticky
```

infra-bot: Manual abort allowed for groups: release-leads, eng-oncall, deploy-admins. If circuit-breaker fires twice within 30m, block reattempts and escalate to infra lead. Audit trail recorded.

claire: I'll run smoke_v6 eval at the 1% and 10% holds and post results. If anything looks off I'll call abort and include snapshots.

emi: I'm on pager 03:50-05:10 UTC. Will ack as required. If I miss an ack within 8m deploybot will hold and page release-leads.

noah: Starting canary now (1%). Posting checkpoints at holds. :rocket:

deploybot: Canary started -> cohort=1% job=db-98022 step=canary-start ts=1955555555. Monitoring live.
